verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS customer-support platform like Pylon, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only compliance certifications (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001) and Vanta-managed compliance. Nothing shows customers can choose a storage region or residency, and certifications are an adjacent control, not region choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
